why: Both sides concern the same function, the project's tangentTheta. B's (1), TΘ = 0 over {Θ = 0}, is the non-item lemma tangentTheta_eq_zero. B states (2), the local formula for every structure, and (3), TΘ a branched ep⁺-subgroupoid of TX, for every branched Θ with no further hypothesis. A has them only conditionally. (2) needs HasIndependentTangentSums Θ (Theorem 9.2.1 (1)), which the project proves only over ℝᵐ (hasIndependentTangentSums_rn) or under slice hypotheses. (3) needs that as well as TangentBranchingHyp Θ, whose field 'TMᵢ is a smooth (sc⁺) submanifold of TX' is left open in the project, and which gets paracompactness of |supp TΘ| only from paracompactness of |X|. These are believed true but are real mathematics, so A ⇒ B fails. A_gives_B_of proves B's conclusion for Θ from A under independence + TangentBranchingHyp. A_gives_B_rn does so over ℝᵐ under paracompact |X| + smooth TMᵢ. Both #rt_check OK. B ⇒ A fails for a genuine reason. A contains facts that B does not state: TMᵢ closed in TU(x), TMᵢ a sub-M-polyfold of TX, paracompactness of |supp TΘ| from that of |X|, TangentBranchingHyp from its first field, and the Θ = 0 instances. Universes at 0 where present.
